title: pdp_zrot
description: `pdp_zrot` applies zoom and rotation to PDP data. Its second inlet sets the zoom amount and its third inlet sets the rotation angle; `zoomx` and `zoomy` set per-axis zoom, while `centerx` and `centery` set the transformation center using normalized coordinates from (0, 0) at the top left to (1, 1) at the bottom right.
